verdict.rationale: Milvus Lite lets a user spin up a local, file-backed database with `MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db")`, which works as an isolated sandbox. It shares the same API and client code as Standalone and Distributed production deployments, so you can test there before pointing at production. Database- and collection-level RBAC and multi-tenancy isolation give further ways to separate test from production data. Missing for 10: no explicit sandbox or staging feature, no documented way to clone, snapshot or branch production data into a test copy, Lite covers only 'most' features so parity gaps remain, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of this testing workflow.
